audit.whatIsWrong: Condemn was called a 'defensive stun' and 'wall-stun' with no condition and no cooldown.
audit.why: Condemn knocks the target back; it only impales and stuns if they collide with terrain. Fighting her in open ground removes the CC entirely. It is also 20/18/16/14/12 — a 20-second window at rank 1 that the text never gave you.
audit.corrected: Every Condemn line now carries the terrain condition and the 20s rank-1 cooldown, so 'fight away from walls' becomes an actual instruction.

audit.whatIsWrong: Tumble was treated as a dodge with no timer, so 'dash on top before she Tumbles' had nothing behind it.
audit.why: Tumble is 6/5/4/3/2 and is an attack reset — at rank 1 there is a real six-second window between them, and the reset is the tell that her burst is starting.
audit.corrected: Tumble's 6s rank-1 cooldown added to the level 1-3 spike and the wants lines.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] said Perfect Execution's first cast 'dashes through her untargetably', and Silver Bolts was described as procing on 'every third auto'.
audit.why: Riot's Perfect Execution text is a leap that damages enemies struck — there is no untargetability on either cast, and a player who believes there is will commit into her attacks expecting immunity. Silver Bolts procs on the third consecutive attack OR ABILITY against the same target, so your spells advance it too.
audit.corrected: The false untargetability removed and the leap described as it works; Silver Bolts now says attack or ability.

edits.before: Vayne tumbles (Q) to dodge your Five Point Strike (Q) and chunks you with Silver Bolts (W) percent-HP true damage on every third hit — you have no Shroud yet, so eat minimal poke and last-hit at Q range.
edits.after: Vayne Tumbles (Q) every 6s at rank 1 to dodge your Five Point Strike and chunks you with Silver Bolts (W) — every third attack or ability on the same target — so eat minimal poke and last-hit at Q range.

edits.before: Perfect Execution (R) is your spike: cast one dashes through her untargetably, cast two re-dashes from any angle and executes off her missing HP — your hardest all-in, before any Guardian Angel exists.
edits.after: Perfect Execution (R) is your spike: cast one leaps through her — it deals damage, it does not make you untargetable — and cast two re-dashes from any angle to execute off her missing HP. Your hardest all-in.

edits.before: Two-item Vayne kites your dash with Tumble (Q), Condemns (E) you into a wall mid-combo, and her Silver Bolts (W) percent-max-HP true damage out-DPS your burst no matter how much HP you stack.
edits.after: Two-item Vayne kites your dash with Tumble (Q), Condemns (E) you into a wall for the stun mid-combo, and her Silver Bolts (W) percent-max-HP true damage out-DPS your burst however much HP you stack.

edits.before: Land E (Shuriken Flip) to mark her and dash on top before she can Tumble (Q) the gap away
edits.after: Land E (Shuriken Flip) to mark her and dash on top before her 6s Tumble opens the gap

edits.before: Drop Shroud (W) to bait her Condemn (E) and blank her Silver Bolts auto-pattern, then commit the R execute untargetably
edits.after: Drop Shroud to bait Condemn — it is targeted, so it cannot fire on you in smoke — then commit the R execute in that 20s gap

edits.before: Hold Condemn (E) to knock you into a wall the instant you E-dash onto her, then walk away
edits.after: Hold Condemn (E), 20s at rank 1, to pin you against a wall the instant you E-dash on

edits.before: Tumble (Q) to dodge your Q and your E-dash, kiting while stacking Silver Bolts (W) third-hits to shred your HP
edits.after: Tumble every 6s to dodge your Q and your E-dash, kiting while stacking Silver Bolts (W) third-hits to shred you

edits.before: Vayne owns the first levels here — you only have Five Point Strike (Q) and no Shroud, and she Tumbles (Q) to dodge your kunai while chunking you with Silver Bolts (W) percent-HP true damage on every third auto. Don't walk into her Tumble range to force a trade; last-hit with the tip of your Q and accept a little poke. Her Condemn (E) is a defensive stun she'll hold for your engage, so she has almost no kill pressure on you while you're just farming — deny her a clean wall-pin and survive to your power level.
edits.after: Vayne owns the first levels here — you only have Five Point Strike (Q) and no Shroud, and she Tumbles every 6s at rank 1 to dodge your kunai while chunking you with Silver Bolts (W) percent-HP true damage on every third attack or ability. Don't walk into her range to force a trade; last-hit with the tip of your Q and accept a little poke. Condemn (E) is a knockback she holds for your engage, and it only stuns if it pins you on terrain — so stay off walls, deny her the pin, and survive to your power level.

edits.before: This is your lane once Twilight Shroud (W) is online — drop the smoke to go untargetable and her Tumble-and-shoot pattern has nothing to lock onto, blanking both her autos and her Condemn. At 6 your Perfect Execution (R) is the whole matchup: land E (Shuriken Flip) to mark her, dash in, then cast one and cast two execute off her missing HP before any Guardian Angel exists. The one thing that beats you is eating her Condemn (E) into a wall mid-combo, so bait it with a Shroud or a feint, then commit the all-in.
edits.after: This is your lane once Twilight Shroud (W) is online — inside the smoke she cannot select you, so her autos and the targeted Condemn both fizzle and her Tumble-and-shoot pattern has nothing to lock onto. At 6 your Perfect Execution (R) is the whole matchup: land E (Shuriken Flip) to mark her, dash in, then cast one and cast two execute off her missing HP before any Guardian Angel exists. The one thing that beats you is a Condemn into a wall mid-combo, so fight in open ground and bait the 20s cooldown first.

edits.before: With Twilight Shroud (W) online you go untargetable and blank her autos and Condemn — drop smoke to reset any trade she opens and her kite pattern stalls.
edits.after: With Twilight Shroud (W) online she cannot select you, so her autos and the targeted Condemn both fizzle — drop smoke to reset any trade she opens.

edits.before: Your empowered passive auto plus Shroud resets punish any greedy step-up, and her Condemn does nothing while you're untargetable inside the smoke.
edits.after: Your empowered attack plus Shroud resets punish a greedy step-up, and Condemn only stuns if it pins you on terrain — so fight in open ground.

edits.before: Perfect Execution (R) dashes through her untargetably then re-dashes to execute off missing HP — catch her before any Guardian Angel and she dies in the combo.
edits.after: Perfect Execution leaps through her then re-dashes to execute off missing HP — catch her before any Guardian Angel and she dies inside the combo.

edits.before: Dive her early — shroud her condemn, all-in. Akali wins the Condemn cooldown windows.
edits.after: Dive her early — shroud denies Condemn, all-in. Akali wins the Condemn windows.

edits.before: Shroud rewrites any trade he starts. Only take the trade when Vayne's Condemn is down.
edits.after: Shroud rewrites any trade she starts. Take it when Vayne's Condemn is down, 20s.

edits.before: - Vayne Condemn: matchup-defining — Wall-stun. Shroud-dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Vayne Condemn, 20s at rank 1: matchup-defining — it stuns only if it pins you on terrain, and it cannot target you in Shroud. - Tumble, 6s. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.

edits.before: Wall-stun. Shroud-dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: A knockback that stuns only on terrain, 20s at rank 1. Bait it out.

notes: The claim that Perfect Execution's first cast passes through her 'untargetably' is false — Riot's text is a leap that damages enemies struck, with no untargetability on either cast. That is the same class of error the Tahm Kench mirror caught (their text had R1 knocking them airborne), so it may be templated across other Akali matchups and is worth a global sweep. Condemn's stun is terrain-conditional and was written as unconditional in four places.
